text: { "entries"  : [ { "name_han" : "太乙神针心法" , "logic_thesis" : "This text proves that therapeutic efficacy is not primarily in the instrument but in the alignment of intention, timing, and vital energy between practitioner and patient. Heat-needle therapy works when the operator's shen and qi conduct through the tool as a medium; technique without inner cultivation is mechanically incomplete. Therefore healing is a moral-energetic act as much as a technical one." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: disease is local blockage of qi and blood that cold or stagnation has fixed. 2. Inference: external heat can reopen channels only if it matches the patient's qi depth and timing. 3. Inference: the needle is a conductor; the true agent is the practitioner's cultivated intention and breath. 4. Inference: wrong timing or agitated mind scatters the effect even with correct point selection. 5. Conclusion: mastery requires simultaneous technical protocol and internal stillness, proving medicine and cultivation share one causality." , "logic_practice" : "1. Before needling or any BaZi remedial act, regulate breath and clear intent so the intervention is not scattered. 2. Choose action windows by clock/seasonal qi (Zi Wu, seasonal nodes) not only by symptom labels. 3. Treat the chart's blocked elements as channels: warm/strengthen weak stems carefully rather than over-stimulate. 4. Keep practitioner ethics (calm, non-greedy motive) as part of the method, not optional virtue. 5. Log outcomes vs. state of mind to verify that mental preparation changes results." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike pure acupuncture point manuals that catalog locations, this text centers the operator's xin-fa as causal. Unlike alchemical neidan texts that ignore the body as clinic, it keeps clinical technique. The difference is the claim that tool efficacy is downstream of cultivated presence." } , { "name_han" : "内功图说" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that internal strength is trainable anatomy of breath, posture, and intention rather than mysterious talent. The body is a diagram of qi pathways that can be systematically opened; illustrated progressive practice converts abstract theory into reproducible skill. Thus cultivation is pedagogical engineering, not vague mysticism." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: qi follows form and breath; disordered form yields disordered qi. 2. Inference: correct postures and sequences create measurable changes in circulation and strength. 3. Inference: progressive stages (static → moving → integrated) prevent forcing that damages jing. 4. Inference: diagrams externalize the inner map so self-correction is possible without constant teacher presence. 5. Conclusion: neigong success is lawful cause-and-effect of method + consistency, not destiny alone." , "logic_practice" : "1. Map Day Master and weak organs to gentle neigong postures that support, not strain, deficient elements. 2. Practice fixed sequences daily at matching hours (e.g., lung/metal morning) for chart reinforcement. 3. Use body feedback as verification of BaZi luck shifts instead of only abstract predictions. 4. Avoid aggressive forced breathing when chart shows weak Fire/Earth or depleted yin. 5. Treat illustrated stages as curriculum: complete foundations before advanced visualization." , "logic_compare" : "Differs from pure martial manuals that prioritize combat application by insisting health and stillness are primary. Differs from abstract Daozang theory by making every claim drawable and practiceable. Its edge is visual pedagogy as proof structure." } , { "name_han" : "博济仙方" , "logic_thesis" : "It argues that medical knowledge is incomplete unless it serves broad relief of suffering, not elite or esoteric monopoly. Formulas are validated by compassionate application across many conditions; the moral frame of jì (relief) is itself part of therapeutic legitimacy. Efficacy and charity are one continuum." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: illness is widespread and unevenly accessible to care. 2. Inference: collecting and disseminating workable formulas multiplies lives saved. 3. Inference: secrecy that hoards cures contradicts the Dao of healing. 4. Inference: formulas that work in common practice outrank theoretically pure but unused recipes. 5. Conclusion: the physician-Daoist's duty is transmission for public benefit, proving virtue is structural to medicine." , "logic_practice" : "1. Prefer remedies and chart advice that ordinary people can apply without rare materials. 2. When reading BaZi for others, prioritize reducing harm over impressive jargon. 3. Build a personal formulary of ethical lifestyle adjustments tied to common five-element imbalances. 4. Share verified methods; do not use occult aura to create dependency. 5. Measure success by relief of suffering, not by fee or reputation." , "logic_compare" : "Unlike imperial pharmacopeias focused on court standards, this text stresses popular salvation through medicine. Unlike pure ritual texts, it stays in materia medica. The distinction is moral universalism as the organizing principle of the pharmacopeia." } , { "name_han" : "先天斛食濟煉幽科" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that postmortem distress and living fate are linked through a shared cosmic food-and-refinement economy: the hungry dead can be nourished and refined, and that act rectifies yin imbalance affecting the living. Salvation is not sentiment but ritual technology that transforms qi quality of the underworld strata. Thus filial-cosmic duty includes active jilian (salvation-refinement)." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: beings without proper nourishment remain turbulent yin, disturbing the order of worlds. 2. Inference: ritual hu food (dǒu measure of food) symbolically and energetically feeds the unsatisfied. 3. Inference: feeding without refining leaves beings dependent; refining elevates their qi grade. 4. Inference: elevated yin reduces karmic pressure on descendants and the locale. 5. Conclusion: structured 济炼 is causal intervention in multi-generational destiny, not mere mourning theater." , "logic_practice" : "1. When charts show ancestral sha, heavy yin, or sudden multi-generational patterns, consider ritual hygiene alongside personal cultivation. 2. Practice merit dedication: transfer good deeds toward unresolved family dead as part of luck repair. 3. Distinguish feeding (comfort) from refining (transformation); aim for both in ethical practice. 4. Align ritual timing with underworld-related hours/days if engaged in formal liturgy. 5. Use the logic to interpret BaZi 'ghost' stars as signals of unfinished relational qi, not only superstition." , "logic_compare" : "More primordial (先天) and doctrinal than later popular iron-pot feeding collections; less entertainment, more soteriological structure. Compared with pure merit-ledgers, it acts on the dead directly rather than only on the living's score." } , { "name_han" : "青玄濟煉鐵罐施食全集" , "logic_thesis" : "It demonstrates that large-scale salvation requires a complete operational system—roles, vessels (iron pot), visualization, and sequential modules—because chaotic compassion fails. The iron pot is a concentration vessel that gathers and redistributes transformative force to innumerable spirits. Completeness of kit and rite is what makes mass 济炼 possible." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: infinite suffering souls exceed ad hoc prayer capacity. 2. Inference: a standardized complete collection ensures no critical step is omitted. 3. Inference: the iron pot focuses fire and food transformation into a shared field. 4. Inference: Qingxuan (blue-mystery) pantheon authorizes and structures the field. 5. Conclusion: ritual completeness is an engineering claim: full protocol → stable large-scale effect." , "logic_practice" : "1. For complex BaZi or life crises, use complete checklists (body, mind, ethics, environment) rather than one lucky charm. 2. Create a personal 'vessel' practice: one dedicated altar act that concentrates intention repeatedly. 3. Sequence: open field → nourish → refine → dedicate → close; never skip close. 4. Prefer systematic daily micro-merit over sporadic intense emotion. 5. Train visualization of light/food distribution as mind training for expansive compassion without burnout." , "logic_compare" : "Broader and more encyclopedic than condensed 集要 versions; more Qingxuan-lineage colored than generic hungry-ghost rites. Differs from 先天斛食 by emphasizing the iron-pot technology and full operational corpus." } , { "name_han" : "關燈散花科" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that light and beauty are not decoration but operational agents: lamps mark stages of awareness, and scattering flowers disperses merit and softens hard yin. Closing lamps is a controlled transition, teaching that endings must be ritualized or residual energy disorders the field. Aesthetics here are soteriological mechanics." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: light guides and orders wandering yin; darkness without guide breeds confusion. 2. Inference: sequenced lamps map progressive stages of release. 3. Inference: flowers (xiang/se offering) convert sensory beauty into transferable merit. 4. Inference: closing lamps seals the process so spirits do not remain half-invited. 5. Conclusion: controlled illumination and aesthetic offering are causal tools for safe passage." , "logic_practice" : "1. Use light hygiene in life design: clear lighting and clean spaces as yang support for weak Fire charts. 2. Practice intentional endings—close workdays, relationships, and rites cleanly to avoid lingering qi. 3. Offer beauty (flowers, music, careful speech) as merit, not vanity, when cultivating. 4. In BaZi counseling, recommend graceful completion rituals for unfinished grief. 5. Avoid perpetual 'open' spiritual states without closure protocols." , "logic_compare" : "Narrower and more aesthetic-symbolic than full 施食 corpora; focuses on lamp-flower modules rather than full feeding. Differs from pure scripture recitation by treating sensory offerings as primary causal media." } , { "name_han" : "玄門開位科" , "logic_thesis" : "It argues that sacred work cannot begin until seats of authority and order are correctly opened: hierarchy of spirits, roles of priests, and spatial positions must be installed first. Without 开位, subsequent rites lack legitimate channeling structure. Order precedes power." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: cosmic and ritual efficacy flow through appointed offices, not raw will. 2. Inference: opening seats invites and stabilizes the correct agents. 3. Inference: wrong or missing seats misdirect force and create ritual risk. 4. Inference: the Daoist gate (玄门) is defined by this lawful invitation protocol. 5. Conclusion: legitimacy and sequence are prerequisites to any transformative rite." , "logic_practice" : "1. Before major life decisions or remedies, establish roles: what is your duty, what is heaven's, what is others'. 2. In chart reading, open with correct framework (Day Master, strength, useful god) before techniques. 3. Cultivate respect for proper teachers/lineages when practicing advanced methods. 4. Arrange living space with clear 'seats' for work, rest, and altar to reduce chaotic qi. 5. Never skip foundation setup when starting cultivation or client sessions." , "logic_compare" : "Preparatory rather than soteriological climax texts like 施食. Unlike personal merit books, it is about institutional/ritual office. Its unique claim: authority structure is itself a technology." } , { "name_han" : "了凡四訓" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves destiny is real but not absolute: fate is a probability field that can be rewritten by quantified virtue, repentance, and directed vows. Yuan Huang's case is presented as empirical evidence that moral causality overrides astrological fatalism. Therefore BaZi describes default trajectory, not final prison." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: traditional prediction said Yuan's life was fixed (rank, heirlessness, lifespan). 2. Inference: after meeting the Chan master, he practiced systematic reform of faults and accumulation of good deeds. 3. Inference: life outcomes diverged from the original prediction in measurable ways. 4. Inference: the mechanism is karma-response (感应), not random luck. 5. Conclusion: charts are starting conditions; moral agency is a co-author of destiny." , "logic_practice" : "1. Read BaZi as default script; design a counter-script of concrete daily virtues. 2. Keep a written fault-repentance log; change one measurable habit per month. 3. Make specific vows with deadlines (not vague wishes) tied to chart weak points (e.g., patience for weak Earth). 4. Track life events vs. merit practice to test personal 感应. 5. Teach clients empowerment without denying structure: both map and tiller." , "logic_compare" : "More autobiographical-empirical than abstract Confucian ethics; more lay-accessible than monastic vinaya. Differs from pure Daoist ritual salvation by placing the living individual's moral accounting at the center of fate change." } , { "name_han" : "安士全書" , "logic_thesis" : "It argues that social order, animal life, and personal destiny share one moral physics: cruelty and lust generate precise retributions, while restraint and kindness generate protection. Extensive stories function as inductive proof that 因果 is public law, not private opinion. Stabilizing the world (安士) requires educating this law." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: human communities collapse when people deny moral consequence. 2. Inference: case collections across domains (killing, sex, speech) show patterned outcomes. 3. Inference: protecting life and purifying the mind are highest-yield interventions. 4. Inference: teaching these patterns is itself an act of world-stabilization. 5. Conclusion: cosmology, ethics, and social peace are one system." , "logic_practice" : "1. Adopt non-harm and sexual restraint as high-leverage luck practices alongside chart remedies. 2. When BaZi shows violence or peach-blossom risks, prioritize ethical boundaries over talismans. 3. Use story-based teaching for clients resistant to abstract karma theory. 4. Include animal and speech ethics in daily merit, not only temple donations. 5. Read personal disasters as feedback loops to correct, not only as 'bad luck pillars'." , "logic_compare" : "Broader and more encyclopedic-inductive than 了凡's personal narrative. More lay Buddhist-Confucian synthesis than liturgical Daoist texts. Its method is mass case proof for public morality." } , { "name_han" : "文帝孝經" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that filial piety is not mere family etiquette but the root axis of cosmic response: how one treats parents calibrates heaven's treatment of the self. Wenchang's authority links literary-success destiny to filial substance. Career and exam luck are downstream of xiao." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: Wenchang oversees culture, rank, and moral record. 2. Inference: filial conduct is the primary exam of character before other merits count fully. 3. Inference: unfilial talent becomes unstable or punished success. 4. Inference: sincere xiao realigns the person with generative heaven-earth order. 5. Conclusion: destiny in study/office is moral-filial before it is intellectual." , "logic_practice" : "1. For charts seeking fame/exam luck (Wen chang related), audit real filial behavior first. 2. Repair parent relationships as a BaZi remedy, not only wear metal/water accessories. 3. Express xiao in concrete support and respect, not ritual performance alone. 4. When Officer/Seal stars are sought, cultivate deference and gratitude daily. 5. Use ancestral remembrance to stabilize yin-yang family field." , "logic_compare" : "More focused than general merit ledgers; filial virtue is the master key, not one item among hundreds. Differs from Buddhist filial sutras by being under Wenchang's literary-destiny jurisdiction." } , { "name_han" : "蕉窗十則" , "logic_thesis" : "It argues that a scholar's fate is shaped by small, repeated window-side disciplines—speech, reading, desire, association—more than by grand gestures. Ten rules compress elite self-governance into portable law. Subtle daily leakage of virtue explains why talented people fail." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: literati destiny is sensitive to purity of mind and conduct. 2. Inference: most damage comes from minor, habitual faults (idle talk, lust of the eye, bad companions). 3. Inference: ten concise rules cover the main leak channels. 4. Inference: keeping them continuously outperforms occasional large donations. 5. Conclusion: micro-ethics is macro-destiny for the educated class." , "logic_practice" : "1. Translate the ten rules into a personal daily checklist tied to your worst chart weaknesses. 2. Guard speech and media diet as qi hygiene. 3. Limit stimulating company and nightlife when chart shows peach blossom/imbalance. 4. Prefer short non-negotiable rules over complex spiritual programs you will abandon. 5. Review weekly which rule leaked and patch it." , "logic_compare" : "Shorter and scholar-lifestyle specific versus massive 功过格 inventories. Less narrative than 了凡, more aphoristic code. Its difference is compression: few rules, high adherence." } , { "name_han" : "文昌帝君功過格" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that destiny can be managed by double-entry moral bookkeeping under Wenchang's gaze: every act has a point value, and the running balance predicts response. Quantification makes self-cultivation auditable. Heaven's court is modeled as an accountable bureaucracy of merit." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: vague good intentions do not reliably change fate. 2. Inference: assigning points forces precision about what counts as good or harm. 3. Inference: daily recording creates feedback and prevents self-deception. 4. Inference: Wenchang's domain links the ledger especially to scholarly and official outcomes. 5. Conclusion: numerical merit accounting is a technology of destiny engineering." , "logic_practice" : "1. Keep a daily merit/demerit log with simple scores. 2. Weight actions relevant to your aims (study, speech, filial acts). 3. When BaZi luck is low, increase high-value merits deliberately rather than only waiting for cycles. 4. Review monthly totals and correlate with events. 5. Avoid 'buying' points while leaving core vices intact—quality still rules." , "logic_compare" : "More Wenchang- and scholar-oriented than Lüzu or comprehensive compilations. More quantitative than 蕉窗十則's qualitative rules. Template for later expanded ledgers." } , { "name_han" : "太微仙君純陽呂祖師功過格" , "logic_thesis" : "It establishes that immortal supervision (Taiwei/Lüzu) expands the ledger beyond literati success to full Daoist self-transformation: faults of desire, deception, and wasted qi are scored as obstacles to transcendence. The ledger is a ladder from ordinary morality toward xian-hood. Accountability is celestial and alchemical." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: Lüzu embodies perfected yang and active salvation of beings. 2. Inference: aspiring practitioners need stricter, more interior standards than civic ethics alone. 3. Inference: scoring includes subtle mental faults that drain jing-qi-shen. 4. Inference: merits include teaching, healing, and liberating others, not only personal purity. 5. Conclusion: the ledger is a cultivation syllabus under immortal inspection." , "logic_practice" : "1. Add interior items to your log: anger, lustful fantasy, deceitful cleverness. 2. Count conservation of sexual and emotional energy as merit for weak charts. 3. Include helping others understand fate/cultivation as high merit. 4. Use Lüzu-style standards when your goal is deep neidan, not only career luck. 5. Pair scoring with repentance that actually restores qi (sleep, stillness)." , "logic_compare" : "More immortal-Daoist and interior than Wenchang's exam-career focus. Less encyclopedic than 彙纂, more lineage-flavored. Emphasizes transcendence metrics over purely social morality." } , { "name_han" : "彙纂功過格" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that moral causality needs a comprehensive codex: by compiling many sources into one ledger, contradictions are reduced and ordinary people gain a full map of actionable good and harm. Completeness prevents loopholes of selective virtue. Systematization is itself a form of compassion." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: single-author ledgers are partial and class-biased. 2. Inference: compiling (彙纂) aggregates communal ethical intelligence. 3. Inference: broader categories catch more real-life situations. 4. Inference: users can apply the system across family, market, and ritual life. 5. Conclusion: a unified encyclopedia of scores is the practical operating system of popular destiny reform." , "logic_practice" : "1. Use a comprehensive checklist covering speech, trade, sex, filiality, killing, and mind. 2. Customize weights to your BaZi risk areas but do not delete whole categories. 3. When life is complex, prefer full audit over one-dimensional 'donate more'. 4. Teach family members a shared simplified version for household luck. 5. Periodically update your personal codex as self-knowledge deepens." , "logic_compare" : "More synthetic and exhaustive than Wenchang or Lüzu single-line ledgers. Less autobiographical than 了凡. Its differentia is editorial compilation as the path to universal applicability." } , { "name_han" : "醫道還元" , "logic_thesis" : "It argues that true medicine returns (返元) to the Daoist root: yin-yang, five phases, and pre-heaven order—not endless symptomatic complexity. When diagnosis forgets origin, treatment multiplies without curing. Healing is restoration of original pattern, not novelty of drugs." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: the body is a microcosm of cosmic generation. 2. Inference: disease is departure from yuan pattern (imbalance of phases/qi). 3. Inference: therapies that only chase branches create dependency and iatrogenic chaos. 4. Inference: returning to root principles simplifies and deepens efficacy. 5. Conclusion: medical Dao is metaphysical alignment before pharmacology." , "logic_practice" : "1. In BaZi health reading, always return to Day Master root and useful god, not symptom lists alone. 2. Prefer lifestyle and elemental balance that restore baseline over aggressive stacking of remedies. 3. Study classic phase theory when interpreting modern illness narratives. 4. Ask 'what original order is broken?' before 'what product to buy?'. 5. Cultivate yuanqi (sleep, breath, calm) as primary medicine." , "logic_compare" : "More philosophical-reductive than formula compendia like 经验奇方. Closer to neidan logic than pure clinical empiricism. Its claim is methodological: origin first, techniques second." } , { "name_han" : "經驗奇方" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves medical truth by accumulated clinical experience: odd/wonderful formulas earn authority because they repeatedly work in practice, not because they are theoretically elegant. Empiricism disciplines theory. The archive of verified anomalies expands what is possible in healing." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: many real cures begin as unexpected clinical successes. 2. Inference: recording and transmitting them preserves hard-won knowledge. 3. Inference: 'strange' does not mean unlawful; it means previously unsystematized. 4. Inference: experience across cases is a second scripture. 5. Conclusion: practice-validated formulas correct and enrich classical theory." , "logic_practice" : "1. Keep a personal case log of what actually improved your or clients' conditions. 2. Test BaZi remedies in small, reversible experiments; keep what works. 3. Do not reject unconventional supports if ethically safe and evidenced in experience. 4. Separate marketing '奇' from documented 经验. 5. Feed empirical results back into your theoretical map annually." , "logic_compare" : "Opposite pole from 医道还原's root-principle emphasis: this text trusts the clinic's surprises. Unlike ritual soteriology, it stays pharmacological/experiential. Difference is epistemology: cases over cosmology." } , { "name_han" : "太极仙翁祭炼玄科" , "logic_thesis" : "It demonstrates that sacrifice (祭) and refinement (炼) are a single circuit: offerings open relationship with Taiji immortal authority, and refinement transforms the recipients and the field. Without offering, refinement lacks mandate; without refinement, offering is bribery. The mysterious rite (玄科) unites devotion and alchemy." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: Taiji Immortal stands at the generative pivot of yin-yang. 2. Inference: proper offering aligns the ritualist with that pivot. 3. Inference: refinement uses that alignment to upgrade suffering beings' qi. 4. Inference: the combined 祭炼 benefits both the dead and the living field. 5. Conclusion: dual action—gift plus transformation—is the complete soteriological logic." , "logic_practice" : "1. Pair any request (prayer, luck aim) with self-refinement; do not only petition. 2. Offer substance (time, wealth, restraint) that costs you, proving sincerity. 3. Visualize Taiji balance when chart shows extreme polar swings. 4. Structure personal rites: open → offer → refine intention/behavior → dedicate → close. 5. Treat ancestors and personal vices with the same 祭炼 logic: feed truthfully, transform actively." , "logic_compare" : "More focused on the 祭+炼 couple and Taiji immortal identity than iron-pot feeding mega-corpora. Less purely moral-ledger than 了凡 tradition. Distinct as devotion-alchemy fusion under a specific immortal frame." } , { "name_han" : "金箓分灯捲帘科仪全集" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that high Daoist liturgy (Golden Register class) works by staged revelation: dividing lamps transmits true fire/light lineage, rolling the curtain discloses the sacred presence gradually. Completeness of the ritual corpus protects theocracy of light from amateur compression. Access to heaven is procedural." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: Golden Register rites address cosmic and communal salvation at high register. 2. Inference: light must be divided from a legitimate source (分灯) to empower the altar. 3. Inference: the curtain regulates revelation; abrupt exposure disorders the field. 4. Inference: a complete collection preserves sequence integrity. 5. Conclusion: hierarchical light-transmission and unveiling are the operative metaphysics of major jiao ritual." , "logic_practice" : "1. In cultivation, receive 'light' from stable sources (authentic teaching, calm mind) before advanced work. 2. Reveal truths to yourself and clients in stages; avoid dumping entire chart darkness at once. 3. Maintain ceremonial seriousness for major life transitions (marriage, burial, enterprise). 4. Use progressive illumination: foundation → intermediate → deep. 5. Respect that some practices require full sequence, not excerpted hacks." , "logic_compare" : "Liturgical-high and communal versus personal merit books. More formal and complete than short 关灯 modules. Differs from Qingxuan iron-pot feeding by Golden Register framework and lamp-curtain technology rather than food-salvation emphasis." } , { "name_han" : "青玄集要炼度施食科仪" , "logic_thesis" : "It argues that essence can be extracted from vast Qingxuan salvation corpora: a condensed essentials text still performs 炼度 and 施食 if critical nodes are kept. Compression is valid when it preserves causal skeleton, not when it truncates randomly. Portable completeness beats unread encyclopedias." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: full collections are long and hard to perform often. 2. Inference: practitioners need a 集要 that retains open-nourish-refine-liberate-close logic. 3. Inference: essentials must include both feeding and degree-raising, not only one. 4. Inference: correct condensation multiplies frequency of real practice. 5. Conclusion: skillful abridgment is a legitimate soteriological strategy." , "logic_practice" : "1. Design a short daily protocol that still includes all key phases of self-cultivation. 2. For BaZi remedies, keep a minimal effective stack, not twenty concurrent charms. 3. When time-poor, shorten length, not structural integrity. 4. Compare your abridged practice monthly against outcomes to verify nothing critical was cut. 5. Teach clients 10-minute complete loops rather than occasional marathon rituals." , "logic_compare" : "Explicitly abridged versus 全集 iron-pot editions; same Qingxuan family, different packaging. Differs from 先天斛食 by being practical essentials for performance frequency. The key difference is editorial theory of the minimal effective rite." } , { "name_han" : "全真青玄济炼铁罐施食全集" , "logic_thesis" : "It proves that Quanzhen institutional identity can fully own and transmit the Qingxuan iron-pot salvation system: monastic discipline plus complete 济炼 liturgy yields a stable, repeatable communal technology for liberating the dead and training the living. Lineage branding is not vanity; it guarantees performance standards. Fullness of text equals fullness of duty." , "logic_chain" : "1. Premise: Quanzhen emphasizes disciplined communal cultivation. 2. Inference: adopting Qingxuan iron-pot 施食 integrates outer salvation with inner purity vows. 3. Inference: a labeled complete collection standardizes what 'doing it properly' means in the order. 4. Inference: standardization allows teaching, inspection, and continuity across temples. 5. Conclusion: lineage + complete iron-pot system is a social technology of cosmic care." , "logic_practice" : "1. Bind personal cultivation to a clear lineage-standard checklist to avoid eclectic confusion. 2. Let monastic-style discipline (schedule, celibacy or restraint, simplicity) support any 施食-like merit work. 3. Prefer complete standard operating procedures for serious ancestral work. 4. Use communal practice when possible; group field multiplies individual weak charts. 5. Treat 'complete' as ethical: do not advertise salvation rites you cannot fully perform." , "logic_compare" : "Closest to 青玄济炼铁罐施食全集 but explicitly Quanzhen-framed; more order-disciplinary than free literati morality books. Compared with 集要, it prioritizes completeness and institutional transmission over portability. The difference is Quanzhen custody of the full iron-pot soteriological machine." } ] }

entries.logic_thesis: It proves that internal strength is trainable anatomy of breath, posture, and intention rather than mysterious talent. The body is a diagram of qi pathways that can be systematically opened; illustrated progressive practice converts abstract theory into reproducible skill. Thus cultivation is pedagogical engineering, not vague mysticism.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: qi follows form and breath; disordered form yields disordered qi. 2. Inference: correct postures and sequences create measurable changes in circulation and strength. 3. Inference: progressive stages (static → moving → integrated) prevent forcing that damages jing. 4. Inference: diagrams externalize the inner map so self-correction is possible without constant teacher presence. 5. Conclusion: neigong success is lawful cause-and-effect of method + consistency, not destiny alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Map Day Master and weak organs to gentle neigong postures that support, not strain, deficient elements. 2. Practice fixed sequences daily at matching hours (e.g., lung/metal morning) for chart reinforcement. 3. Use body feedback as verification of BaZi luck shifts instead of only abstract predictions. 4. Avoid aggressive forced breathing when chart shows weak Fire/Earth or depleted yin. 5. Treat illustrated stages as curriculum: complete foundations before advanced visualization.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from pure martial manuals that prioritize combat application by insisting health and stillness are primary. Differs from abstract Daozang theory by making every claim drawable and practiceable. Its edge is visual pedagogy as proof structure.

entries.logic_thesis: It argues that medical knowledge is incomplete unless it serves broad relief of suffering, not elite or esoteric monopoly. Formulas are validated by compassionate application across many conditions; the moral frame of jì (relief) is itself part of therapeutic legitimacy. Efficacy and charity are one continuum.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: illness is widespread and unevenly accessible to care. 2. Inference: collecting and disseminating workable formulas multiplies lives saved. 3. Inference: secrecy that hoards cures contradicts the Dao of healing. 4. Inference: formulas that work in common practice outrank theoretically pure but unused recipes. 5. Conclusion: the physician-Daoist's duty is transmission for public benefit, proving virtue is structural to medicine.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Prefer remedies and chart advice that ordinary people can apply without rare materials. 2. When reading BaZi for others, prioritize reducing harm over impressive jargon. 3. Build a personal formulary of ethical lifestyle adjustments tied to common five-element imbalances. 4. Share verified methods; do not use occult aura to create dependency. 5. Measure success by relief of suffering, not by fee or reputation.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike imperial pharmacopeias focused on court standards, this text stresses popular salvation through medicine. Unlike pure ritual texts, it stays in materia medica. The distinction is moral universalism as the organizing principle of the pharmacopeia.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves that postmortem distress and living fate are linked through a shared cosmic food-and-refinement economy: the hungry dead can be nourished and refined, and that act rectifies yin imbalance affecting the living. Salvation is not sentiment but ritual technology that transforms qi quality of the underworld strata. Thus filial-cosmic duty includes active jilian (salvation-refinement).
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: beings without proper nourishment remain turbulent yin, disturbing the order of worlds. 2. Inference: ritual hu food (dǒu measure of food) symbolically and energetically feeds the unsatisfied. 3. Inference: feeding without refining leaves beings dependent; refining elevates their qi grade. 4. Inference: elevated yin reduces karmic pressure on descendants and the locale. 5. Conclusion: structured 济炼 is causal intervention in multi-generational destiny, not mere mourning theater.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When charts show ancestral sha, heavy yin, or sudden multi-generational patterns, consider ritual hygiene alongside personal cultivation. 2. Practice merit dedication: transfer good deeds toward unresolved family dead as part of luck repair. 3. Distinguish feeding (comfort) from refining (transformation); aim for both in ethical practice. 4. Align ritual timing with underworld-related hours/days if engaged in formal liturgy. 5. Use the logic to interpret BaZi 'ghost' stars as signals of unfinished relational qi, not only superstition.
entries.logic_compare: More primordial (先天) and doctrinal than later popular iron-pot feeding collections; less entertainment, more soteriological structure. Compared with pure merit-ledgers, it acts on the dead directly rather than only on the living's score.

entries.name_han: 青玄濟煉鐵罐施食全集
entries.logic_thesis: It demonstrates that large-scale salvation requires a complete operational system—roles, vessels (iron pot), visualization, and sequential modules—because chaotic compassion fails. The iron pot is a concentration vessel that gathers and redistributes transformative force to innumerable spirits. Completeness of kit and rite is what makes mass 济炼 possible.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: infinite suffering souls exceed ad hoc prayer capacity. 2. Inference: a standardized complete collection ensures no critical step is omitted. 3. Inference: the iron pot focuses fire and food transformation into a shared field. 4. Inference: Qingxuan (blue-mystery) pantheon authorizes and structures the field. 5. Conclusion: ritual completeness is an engineering claim: full protocol → stable large-scale effect.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For complex BaZi or life crises, use complete checklists (body, mind, ethics, environment) rather than one lucky charm. 2. Create a personal 'vessel' practice: one dedicated altar act that concentrates intention repeatedly. 3. Sequence: open field → nourish → refine → dedicate → close; never skip close. 4. Prefer systematic daily micro-merit over sporadic intense emotion. 5. Train visualization of light/food distribution as mind training for expansive compassion without burnout.
entries.logic_compare: Broader and more encyclopedic than condensed 集要 versions; more Qingxuan-lineage colored than generic hungry-ghost rites. Differs from 先天斛食 by emphasizing the iron-pot technology and full operational corpus.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves that light and beauty are not decoration but operational agents: lamps mark stages of awareness, and scattering flowers disperses merit and softens hard yin. Closing lamps is a controlled transition, teaching that endings must be ritualized or residual energy disorders the field. Aesthetics here are soteriological mechanics.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: light guides and orders wandering yin; darkness without guide breeds confusion. 2. Inference: sequenced lamps map progressive stages of release. 3. Inference: flowers (xiang/se offering) convert sensory beauty into transferable merit. 4. Inference: closing lamps seals the process so spirits do not remain half-invited. 5. Conclusion: controlled illumination and aesthetic offering are causal tools for safe passage.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Use light hygiene in life design: clear lighting and clean spaces as yang support for weak Fire charts. 2. Practice intentional endings—close workdays, relationships, and rites cleanly to avoid lingering qi. 3. Offer beauty (flowers, music, careful speech) as merit, not vanity, when cultivating. 4. In BaZi counseling, recommend graceful completion rituals for unfinished grief. 5. Avoid perpetual 'open' spiritual states without closure protocols.
entries.logic_compare: Narrower and more aesthetic-symbolic than full 施食 corpora; focuses on lamp-flower modules rather than full feeding. Differs from pure scripture recitation by treating sensory offerings as primary causal media.

entries.logic_thesis: It argues that sacred work cannot begin until seats of authority and order are correctly opened: hierarchy of spirits, roles of priests, and spatial positions must be installed first. Without 开位, subsequent rites lack legitimate channeling structure. Order precedes power.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: cosmic and ritual efficacy flow through appointed offices, not raw will. 2. Inference: opening seats invites and stabilizes the correct agents. 3. Inference: wrong or missing seats misdirect force and create ritual risk. 4. Inference: the Daoist gate (玄门) is defined by this lawful invitation protocol. 5. Conclusion: legitimacy and sequence are prerequisites to any transformative rite.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Before major life decisions or remedies, establish roles: what is your duty, what is heaven's, what is others'. 2. In chart reading, open with correct framework (Day Master, strength, useful god) before techniques. 3. Cultivate respect for proper teachers/lineages when practicing advanced methods. 4. Arrange living space with clear 'seats' for work, rest, and altar to reduce chaotic qi. 5. Never skip foundation setup when starting cultivation or client sessions.
entries.logic_compare: Preparatory rather than soteriological climax texts like 施食. Unlike personal merit books, it is about institutional/ritual office. Its unique claim: authority structure is itself a technology.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves destiny is real but not absolute: fate is a probability field that can be rewritten by quantified virtue, repentance, and directed vows. Yuan Huang's case is presented as empirical evidence that moral causality overrides astrological fatalism. Therefore BaZi describes default trajectory, not final prison.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: traditional prediction said Yuan's life was fixed (rank, heirlessness, lifespan). 2. Inference: after meeting the Chan master, he practiced systematic reform of faults and accumulation of good deeds. 3. Inference: life outcomes diverged from the original prediction in measurable ways. 4. Inference: the mechanism is karma-response (感应), not random luck. 5. Conclusion: charts are starting conditions; moral agency is a co-author of destiny.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Read BaZi as default script; design a counter-script of concrete daily virtues. 2. Keep a written fault-repentance log; change one measurable habit per month. 3. Make specific vows with deadlines (not vague wishes) tied to chart weak points (e.g., patience for weak Earth). 4. Track life events vs. merit practice to test personal 感应. 5. Teach clients empowerment without denying structure: both map and tiller.
entries.logic_compare: More autobiographical-empirical than abstract Confucian ethics; more lay-accessible than monastic vinaya. Differs from pure Daoist ritual salvation by placing the living individual's moral accounting at the center of fate change.

entries.logic_thesis: It argues that social order, animal life, and personal destiny share one moral physics: cruelty and lust generate precise retributions, while restraint and kindness generate protection. Extensive stories function as inductive proof that 因果 is public law, not private opinion. Stabilizing the world (安士) requires educating this law.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: human communities collapse when people deny moral consequence. 2. Inference: case collections across domains (killing, sex, speech) show patterned outcomes. 3. Inference: protecting life and purifying the mind are highest-yield interventions. 4. Inference: teaching these patterns is itself an act of world-stabilization. 5. Conclusion: cosmology, ethics, and social peace are one system.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Adopt non-harm and sexual restraint as high-leverage luck practices alongside chart remedies. 2. When BaZi shows violence or peach-blossom risks, prioritize ethical boundaries over talismans. 3. Use story-based teaching for clients resistant to abstract karma theory. 4. Include animal and speech ethics in daily merit, not only temple donations. 5. Read personal disasters as feedback loops to correct, not only as 'bad luck pillars'.
entries.logic_compare: Broader and more encyclopedic-inductive than 了凡's personal narrative. More lay Buddhist-Confucian synthesis than liturgical Daoist texts. Its method is mass case proof for public morality.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves that filial piety is not mere family etiquette but the root axis of cosmic response: how one treats parents calibrates heaven's treatment of the self. Wenchang's authority links literary-success destiny to filial substance. Career and exam luck are downstream of xiao.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Wenchang oversees culture, rank, and moral record. 2. Inference: filial conduct is the primary exam of character before other merits count fully. 3. Inference: unfilial talent becomes unstable or punished success. 4. Inference: sincere xiao realigns the person with generative heaven-earth order. 5. Conclusion: destiny in study/office is moral-filial before it is intellectual.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For charts seeking fame/exam luck (Wen chang related), audit real filial behavior first. 2. Repair parent relationships as a BaZi remedy, not only wear metal/water accessories. 3. Express xiao in concrete support and respect, not ritual performance alone. 4. When Officer/Seal stars are sought, cultivate deference and gratitude daily. 5. Use ancestral remembrance to stabilize yin-yang family field.
entries.logic_compare: More focused than general merit ledgers; filial virtue is the master key, not one item among hundreds. Differs from Buddhist filial sutras by being under Wenchang's literary-destiny jurisdiction.

entries.logic_thesis: It argues that a scholar's fate is shaped by small, repeated window-side disciplines—speech, reading, desire, association—more than by grand gestures. Ten rules compress elite self-governance into portable law. Subtle daily leakage of virtue explains why talented people fail.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: literati destiny is sensitive to purity of mind and conduct. 2. Inference: most damage comes from minor, habitual faults (idle talk, lust of the eye, bad companions). 3. Inference: ten concise rules cover the main leak channels. 4. Inference: keeping them continuously outperforms occasional large donations. 5. Conclusion: micro-ethics is macro-destiny for the educated class.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Translate the ten rules into a personal daily checklist tied to your worst chart weaknesses. 2. Guard speech and media diet as qi hygiene. 3. Limit stimulating company and nightlife when chart shows peach blossom/imbalance. 4. Prefer short non-negotiable rules over complex spiritual programs you will abandon. 5. Review weekly which rule leaked and patch it.
entries.logic_compare: Shorter and scholar-lifestyle specific versus massive 功过格 inventories. Less narrative than 了凡, more aphoristic code. Its difference is compression: few rules, high adherence.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves that destiny can be managed by double-entry moral bookkeeping under Wenchang's gaze: every act has a point value, and the running balance predicts response. Quantification makes self-cultivation auditable. Heaven's court is modeled as an accountable bureaucracy of merit.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: vague good intentions do not reliably change fate. 2. Inference: assigning points forces precision about what counts as good or harm. 3. Inference: daily recording creates feedback and prevents self-deception. 4. Inference: Wenchang's domain links the ledger especially to scholarly and official outcomes. 5. Conclusion: numerical merit accounting is a technology of destiny engineering.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Keep a daily merit/demerit log with simple scores. 2. Weight actions relevant to your aims (study, speech, filial acts). 3. When BaZi luck is low, increase high-value merits deliberately rather than only waiting for cycles. 4. Review monthly totals and correlate with events. 5. Avoid 'buying' points while leaving core vices intact—quality still rules.
entries.logic_compare: More Wenchang- and scholar-oriented than Lüzu or comprehensive compilations. More quantitative than 蕉窗十則's qualitative rules. Template for later expanded ledgers.

entries.name_han: 太微仙君純陽呂祖師功過格
entries.logic_thesis: It establishes that immortal supervision (Taiwei/Lüzu) expands the ledger beyond literati success to full Daoist self-transformation: faults of desire, deception, and wasted qi are scored as obstacles to transcendence. The ledger is a ladder from ordinary morality toward xian-hood. Accountability is celestial and alchemical.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Lüzu embodies perfected yang and active salvation of beings. 2. Inference: aspiring practitioners need stricter, more interior standards than civic ethics alone. 3. Inference: scoring includes subtle mental faults that drain jing-qi-shen. 4. Inference: merits include teaching, healing, and liberating others, not only personal purity. 5. Conclusion: the ledger is a cultivation syllabus under immortal inspection.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Add interior items to your log: anger, lustful fantasy, deceitful cleverness. 2. Count conservation of sexual and emotional energy as merit for weak charts. 3. Include helping others understand fate/cultivation as high merit. 4. Use Lüzu-style standards when your goal is deep neidan, not only career luck. 5. Pair scoring with repentance that actually restores qi (sleep, stillness).
entries.logic_compare: More immortal-Daoist and interior than Wenchang's exam-career focus. Less encyclopedic than 彙纂, more lineage-flavored. Emphasizes transcendence metrics over purely social morality.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves that moral causality needs a comprehensive codex: by compiling many sources into one ledger, contradictions are reduced and ordinary people gain a full map of actionable good and harm. Completeness prevents loopholes of selective virtue. Systematization is itself a form of compassion.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: single-author ledgers are partial and class-biased. 2. Inference: compiling (彙纂) aggregates communal ethical intelligence. 3. Inference: broader categories catch more real-life situations. 4. Inference: users can apply the system across family, market, and ritual life. 5. Conclusion: a unified encyclopedia of scores is the practical operating system of popular destiny reform.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Use a comprehensive checklist covering speech, trade, sex, filiality, killing, and mind. 2. Customize weights to your BaZi risk areas but do not delete whole categories. 3. When life is complex, prefer full audit over one-dimensional 'donate more'. 4. Teach family members a shared simplified version for household luck. 5. Periodically update your personal codex as self-knowledge deepens.
entries.logic_compare: More synthetic and exhaustive than Wenchang or Lüzu single-line ledgers. Less autobiographical than 了凡. Its differentia is editorial compilation as the path to universal applicability.

entries.logic_thesis: It argues that true medicine returns (返元) to the Daoist root: yin-yang, five phases, and pre-heaven order—not endless symptomatic complexity. When diagnosis forgets origin, treatment multiplies without curing. Healing is restoration of original pattern, not novelty of drugs.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: the body is a microcosm of cosmic generation. 2. Inference: disease is departure from yuan pattern (imbalance of phases/qi). 3. Inference: therapies that only chase branches create dependency and iatrogenic chaos. 4. Inference: returning to root principles simplifies and deepens efficacy. 5. Conclusion: medical Dao is metaphysical alignment before pharmacology.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi health reading, always return to Day Master root and useful god, not symptom lists alone. 2. Prefer lifestyle and elemental balance that restore baseline over aggressive stacking of remedies. 3. Study classic phase theory when interpreting modern illness narratives. 4. Ask 'what original order is broken?' before 'what product to buy?'. 5. Cultivate yuanqi (sleep, breath, calm) as primary medicine.
entries.logic_compare: More philosophical-reductive than formula compendia like 经验奇方. Closer to neidan logic than pure clinical empiricism. Its claim is methodological: origin first, techniques second.

entries.logic_thesis: It proves medical truth by accumulated clinical experience: odd/wonderful formulas earn authority because they repeatedly work in practice, not because they are theoretically elegant. Empiricism disciplines theory. The archive of verified anomalies expands what is possible in healing.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: many real cures begin as unexpected clinical successes. 2. Inference: recording and transmitting them preserves hard-won knowledge. 3. Inference: 'strange' does not mean unlawful; it means previously unsystematized. 4. Inference: experience across cases is a second scripture. 5. Conclusion: practice-validated formulas correct and enrich classical theory.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Keep a personal case log of what actually improved your or clients' conditions. 2. Test BaZi remedies in small, reversible experiments; keep what works. 3. Do not reject unconventional supports if ethically safe and evidenced in experience. 4. Separate marketing '奇' from documented 经验. 5. Feed empirical results back into your theoretical map annually.
entries.logic_compare: Opposite pole from 医道还原's root-principle emphasis: this text trusts the clinic's surprises. Unlike ritual soteriology, it stays pharmacological/experiential. Difference is epistemology: cases over cosmology.

entries.logic_thesis: It demonstrates that sacrifice (祭) and refinement (炼) are a single circuit: offerings open relationship with Taiji immortal authority, and refinement transforms the recipients and the field. Without offering, refinement lacks mandate; without refinement, offering is bribery. The mysterious rite (玄科) unites devotion and alchemy.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Taiji Immortal stands at the generative pivot of yin-yang. 2. Inference: proper offering aligns the ritualist with that pivot. 3. Inference: refinement uses that alignment to upgrade suffering beings' qi. 4. Inference: the combined 祭炼 benefits both the dead and the living field. 5. Conclusion: dual action—gift plus transformation—is the complete soteriological logic.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Pair any request (prayer, luck aim) with self-refinement; do not only petition. 2. Offer substance (time, wealth, restraint) that costs you, proving sincerity. 3. Visualize Taiji balance when chart shows extreme polar swings. 4. Structure personal rites: open → offer → refine intention/behavior → dedicate → close. 5. Treat ancestors and personal vices with the same 祭炼 logic: feed truthfully, transform actively.
entries.logic_compare: More focused on the 祭+炼 couple and Taiji immortal identity than iron-pot feeding mega-corpora. Less purely moral-ledger than 了凡 tradition. Distinct as devotion-alchemy fusion under a specific immortal frame.

entries.name_han: 金箓分灯捲帘科仪全集
entries.logic_thesis: It proves that high Daoist liturgy (Golden Register class) works by staged revelation: dividing lamps transmits true fire/light lineage, rolling the curtain discloses the sacred presence gradually. Completeness of the ritual corpus protects theocracy of light from amateur compression. Access to heaven is procedural.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Golden Register rites address cosmic and communal salvation at high register. 2. Inference: light must be divided from a legitimate source (分灯) to empower the altar. 3. Inference: the curtain regulates revelation; abrupt exposure disorders the field. 4. Inference: a complete collection preserves sequence integrity. 5. Conclusion: hierarchical light-transmission and unveiling are the operative metaphysics of major jiao ritual.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In cultivation, receive 'light' from stable sources (authentic teaching, calm mind) before advanced work. 2. Reveal truths to yourself and clients in stages; avoid dumping entire chart darkness at once. 3. Maintain ceremonial seriousness for major life transitions (marriage, burial, enterprise). 4. Use progressive illumination: foundation → intermediate → deep. 5. Respect that some practices require full sequence, not excerpted hacks.
entries.logic_compare: Liturgical-high and communal versus personal merit books. More formal and complete than short 关灯 modules. Differs from Qingxuan iron-pot feeding by Golden Register framework and lamp-curtain technology rather than food-salvation emphasis.

entries.name_han: 青玄集要炼度施食科仪
entries.logic_thesis: It argues that essence can be extracted from vast Qingxuan salvation corpora: a condensed essentials text still performs 炼度 and 施食 if critical nodes are kept. Compression is valid when it preserves causal skeleton, not when it truncates randomly. Portable completeness beats unread encyclopedias.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: full collections are long and hard to perform often. 2. Inference: practitioners need a 集要 that retains open-nourish-refine-liberate-close logic. 3. Inference: essentials must include both feeding and degree-raising, not only one. 4. Inference: correct condensation multiplies frequency of real practice. 5. Conclusion: skillful abridgment is a legitimate soteriological strategy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Design a short daily protocol that still includes all key phases of self-cultivation. 2. For BaZi remedies, keep a minimal effective stack, not twenty concurrent charms. 3. When time-poor, shorten length, not structural integrity. 4. Compare your abridged practice monthly against outcomes to verify nothing critical was cut. 5. Teach clients 10-minute complete loops rather than occasional marathon rituals.
entries.logic_compare: Explicitly abridged versus 全集 iron-pot editions; same Qingxuan family, different packaging. Differs from 先天斛食 by being practical essentials for performance frequency. The key difference is editorial theory of the minimal effective rite.

entries.name_han: 全真青玄济炼铁罐施食全集
entries.logic_thesis: It proves that Quanzhen institutional identity can fully own and transmit the Qingxuan iron-pot salvation system: monastic discipline plus complete 济炼 liturgy yields a stable, repeatable communal technology for liberating the dead and training the living. Lineage branding is not vanity; it guarantees performance standards. Fullness of text equals fullness of duty.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Quanzhen emphasizes disciplined communal cultivation. 2. Inference: adopting Qingxuan iron-pot 施食 integrates outer salvation with inner purity vows. 3. Inference: a labeled complete collection standardizes what 'doing it properly' means in the order. 4. Inference: standardization allows teaching, inspection, and continuity across temples. 5. Conclusion: lineage + complete iron-pot system is a social technology of cosmic care.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Bind personal cultivation to a clear lineage-standard checklist to avoid eclectic confusion. 2. Let monastic-style discipline (schedule, celibacy or restraint, simplicity) support any 施食-like merit work. 3. Prefer complete standard operating procedures for serious ancestral work. 4. Use communal practice when possible; group field multiplies individual weak charts. 5. Treat 'complete' as ethical: do not advertise salvation rites you cannot fully perform.
entries.logic_compare: Closest to 青玄济炼铁罐施食全集 but explicitly Quanzhen-framed; more order-disciplinary than free literati morality books. Compared with 集要, it prioritizes completeness and institutional transmission over portability. The difference is Quanzhen custody of the full iron-pot soteriological machine.
